name: Desert Camel
appearance: A single-humped camel with wide padded feet and a rolling gait.

Special attacks.name: Spitting
Special attacks.effectNote: An ill-tempered camel has a 50% chance to spit at someone who tries to ride it or use it as a pack animal. The victim then has a 25% chance of being blinded for 1–3 rounds.

Special attacks.name: Herd stampede
Special attacks.effectNote: A frightened herd has a 25% chance of stampeding. Roll 2d4 camels for each creature in its path that fails to take cover. Each camel deals 1–4 damage to that creature. Trampled creatures stay down until the herd passes.

Handling.name: Carrying capacity
Handling.effectNote: Load by weight in gold pieces: 250 normal, 400 encumbered, 520 fully encumbered. Camels kneel to be loaded and often refuse to rise with more than their encumbered load.

Handling.name: Desert camel use
Handling.effectNote: A steady mount and pack animal that carries heavy loads across difficult terrain.

notes: 1–12 appearing. Steady (12) morale. Animal to semi-intelligent (1–4).
Common, diurnal herd herbivore. The table lists any land for terrain and Nil for alignment, treasure, special defenses, and magic resistance.
TSR, Monstrous Compendium Al-Qadim Appendix (1992), unnumbered Camel leaf (p. 11).

Handling.effectNote: Often trained for years from the strongest desert camels, or selectively bred from retired war camels.
